headlines.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Pulls Back On A Richer Valuation Narrative
headlines.summary: Airbnb (ABNB) has drawn fresh attention after its recent share performance, with the stock down 1.4% on the day and lower over the past week and over the past 3 months. Despite the recent pullback, Airbnb’s momentum over the past year remains strong. The share price shows a 28.08% year-to-date gain and total shareholder return of 49.10% over 12 months, while the 90-day share price return of 9.04% indicates some cooling in shorter-term sentiment.

headlines.title: BI Survey: Budgetary Constraints for 2027 Travel
headlines.summary: Jody Lurie, Bloomberg Intelligence Credit Analyst, discussed her recent Bloomberg Survey covering budgetary constraints for 2027 travel. Lurie spoke with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney and Scarlet Fu.on her recent BI surveys. US vacationers appear poised to spend more in 2027, but inflation is reshaping rather than curbing demand as higher core trip costs squeeze spending on extras, based on Bloomberg Intelligence's seventh US travel survey conducted Oct. 26-Nov. 4. About 71% believe they'll spend more, but only 45% would absorb higher-than-expected costs vs. 50% two years ago, while 53% cite inflation as a reason for bigger budgets. This shift favors midtier hotels and pressures airline and cruise upselling, while generative AI is a nearer-term threat to deal-hunting than booking for Expedia, Booking Holdings and Airbnb.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
